scope: Optional mapping templates on the completed v1 baseline; local macOS arm64 functional regression and report export/readback. Historical M4 measurements retain their original versions and limits.

verified.fresh_install: 43 exact locked wheels, no-index clean virtual environment; docs/v1.1-environment.json
verified.mapping_core: 116 new tests; strict config-only JSON, two-sided structural matching and malformed-input rejection
verified.mapping_ui: 17 new AppTest cases; explicit application, atomic failure, result invalidation, renewed confirmation, reset and log redaction
verified.sample_and_report: Actual 1.1.0 CLI export, independent source recomputation, five-sheet audit and unchanged sources; outputs/v1.1/final/acceptance.json

github.ci_evidence_rule: The actual run and head commit in GitHub Actions are authoritative. This static local record is not evidence of a successful remote run.
github.ci_limitation: GitHub refused the initial workflow push because the existing OAuth credential lacks workflow scope. No additional authorization was requested; source delivery retains the configuration outside .github/workflows/.

not_claimed: A new browser download or download recording; the user waived it and prior evidence is preserved
A new native Excel, application-offline, capacity or performance run for 1.1.0
Whole-computer physical offline verification or new Windows/Linux/Intel Mac/WPS/LibreOffice acceptance
Semantic equivalence of input columns merely because a mapping template matches the structure
Business data upload to GitHub, bundled wheels in Git, or public cloud application hosting
